name: io.github.Finanzgoblin/metavault-mcp
description: MetaVault MCP — multi-protocol yield intelligence for AI agents (Spectra, Morpho, Pendle). 40 tools, 10+ chains, read-only. Covers yield discovery, PT/YT analysis, looping strategies, Morpho integration, MetaVault curation, cross-protocol Pendle comparison, portfolio tracking, on-chain Curve quoting, and more.
